name: Halve
alt: A bar is cut in two again and again, keeping one half each time.

name: Ratchet
alt: A row of tall bars counts down until only stubs are left.

name: Alternate
alt: Solid and hatched stripes swap places on a fixed beat.

name: Saturate
alt: Scattered dots multiply until the square is entirely white.

name: Sequence
alt: Bars of different heights swap places until they rise in order.

name: Classify
alt: Mixed circles, squares and triangles sort themselves into three columns.

name: Replicate
alt: A zigzag on the left is copied line by line on the right.

name: Interrupt
alt: A wave is drawn from left to right, stopped by a line, then carried on.

name: Recall
alt: An outline disappears, then is redrawn slightly differently.

name: Roam
alt: One thick line stays still while thin lines wander around it.

name: Reserve
alt: A grid fills up while its last two rows stay empty.

name: Dissolve And Rebuild
alt: A square crumbles to dust and the dust forms a circle.

name: Find The Keystone
alt: Blocks are lifted out one at a time until one brings the wall down.

name: Join Through A Third
alt: Two blocks stay still while a third piece drops between them and joins them.

name: Exchange
alt: A circle and a square trade places.

name: Hand Over
alt: One figure passes a small block to another and walks away.

name: Leave One Out
alt: A row of bars with a different one missing each time.

name: Hedge
alt: Three lines start out, two stop, and one carries on.

name: Scout
alt: A bar extends in doubling steps until it breaks.

name: Leave Open
alt: A wire cube flips between two ways of being seen.

name: Build In Layers
alt: A coarse image sharpens in stages into a figure.

name: Load And Rest
alt: A press rises and falls on a fixed rhythm, with rests between.

name: Plant
alt: A small dot sits unnoticed until a figure reaches it, and then it bursts.

name: Pull
alt: Items on a shelf go missing, and only the gap is refilled.

name: Keep A Way Home
alt: A dotted line loops far out and swings back to where it started.

name: Triangulate
alt: Three lines from three corners meet at one point.

name: Raise The Cost
alt: A small block climbs steps that get taller each time.

name: Clear And Refill
alt: One field in a grid is blanked, then filled with something new.

name: Delay
alt: A sealed box sinks into the ground while a bar counts time above.

name: Interlock
alt: Three overlapping circles, each sharing a dot with the others.

name: Share And Keep Apart
alt: Three hatchings overlap on one surface, then each shows alone.

name: Breed
alt: One blob is copied, changing slightly at every step.

name: Calibrate
alt: A line drifts away from its mark and is pulled back at fixed points.

name: Allow A Margin
alt: Dots inside a band stay put; the ones outside are moved in.

name: Favour The Rare
alt: Tall bars shrink and short bars grow until they nearly match.

name: Archive
alt: A grid of small squares disappears until only three are left.

name: Cut The Beaten
alt: Points on a graph drop away until only the best on both counts stay.

name: Leave No Winner
alt: Three circles in a ring, each beating the next.

name: Suspend The Rules
alt: Dots march in order, except inside a ring, where they wander.

name: Feed In Oddities
alt: Squares pass on a belt, with one triangle among them.

name: Watch For Clashes
alt: Lines cross and part freely between two fixed banks.
